From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@brightpathhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + PII handling confirmation (BrightPath demo today)

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Brief technical answers below; happy to join the call on 11/12 to walk through evidence.

What is stored by default (Hosted):
- Prompts: by default we persist request payloads (prompts) for troubleshooting and quality monitoring. Retention default is 30 days for Hosted API customers.
- Outputs: generated outputs are also persisted by default and subject to the same 30-day retention.
- Sampling/QA: customers can opt into longer retention for evaluation; sampling for model quality is possible but we provide opt-out.

Opt-out / enterprise controls:
- Opt-out: Enterprise customers can request "no retention" on prompts/outputs for hosted plans via contract addendum; once enabled, requests are not written to long-term logs (ephemeral caches may exist for the request lifecycle but are not persisted).
- Dedicated / Private: For Dedicated and Private deployments, customer data (prompts, outputs, logs) remains inside the customer's VPC/project and is not sent to Redwood-hosted logging systems unless explicitly enabled.

Data residency & where data is stored:
- Region: For Hosted customers we isolate storage by region (e.g., us-west-2, eu-west-1). For BrightPath we can restrict storage to us-west-2 (US-only) and provide the storage bucket identifiers in the audit package.
- Storage: persisted artifacts are stored in encrypted object stores (S3) with server-side encryption and customer- or Redwood-managed KMS keys as agreed in the contract.

Access controls & audit logging:
- Access: access to persisted prompts/outputs is limited to a small set of engineers and SREs for troubleshooting, gated by least-privilege IAM roles and Just-In-Time (JIT) access where applicable.
- Audit logs: all accesses to logs/artifacts are recorded in our audit system. Audit log retention is 365 days by default; we can provide a longer retention window on request for compliance purposes.
- Redaction: we can run automatic redaction pipelines on stored logs (PII tokenization/masking) before making samples available for review. The sample_redacted_logs.txt attached demonstrates that output formatting.

Encryption & SOC 2 evidence:
- Encryption: data at rest is encrypted with AES-256 and keys managed via AWS KMS (we also support customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private customers). TLS 1.2+ in transit.
- SOC 2: attaching redwood_security_whitepaper_v2.pdf and a link to our SOC 2 report in the drive folder (see links). We will provide an evidence bundle for review on the 11/12 call.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Confirm desired retention setting for BrightPath (default 30 days / 90 days / no retention) — please reply with your preference before the 11/12 call.
2) We'll prepare the evidence bundle (SOC 2 excerpts, bucket IDs, KMS key metadata, sample redacted logs) and share via the Drive link prior to the meeting.
3) Marissa will send the mutual action plan and procurement checklist (attached).

Happy to jump on the call with your security and legal teams.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
